up: For assay CHEMBL4649956, return the activity values, structures, and ChEMBL IDs of the tested compounds. Include the following columns for each matching activity record: molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_value, standard_units, and standard_relation. Do not require any additional filters (e.g., on assay type, confidence score, or document type).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649956';
